inputs.text: Daniel Rubenstein’s talk of “success” and political resolution looks like cover for keeping the operation—and the pressure on Iran—alive. Israel’s refusal to bend on Iran’s nuclear and missile programs makes the peace language sound more like narrative management than a genuine change of course. They want the public to accept both stories at once because that contradiction keeps scrutiny away from who benefits from the operation continuing.
